proactive.about: Runs Adam didn't start (docs/runbooks/proactive.md): message is blocked there; they speak only through sendTool.

projects.about: jorah-projects (docs/plan/11-project-mode.md section 5). project_pause is in read on purpose: pausing is always free, even frozen. project_status returns only counts, ids and times, so it stays a read; project_digest carries run-written text, so it marks the chat. project_start (section 5.1) is free in Adam's clean typed chat and a card with his exact words after outside text or by voice; project_connect and project_set_level (level 1 is a schedule) are always a card.
